description: This Java class implements a cursor-based result set handler for database query pagination, supporting operations such as fetching and closing cursor results.

classes.name: CursorResultSet
classes.description: A specialized result set handler that manages database cursor paging through fetch operations, extending AbstractCursorHandler.

methods.name: CursorResultSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cursor fetching with a specific statement, cursor name, and fetch size.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method invocation dynamically, supporting 'close' and 'next' methods.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the cursor; if at end, re-executes the query to fetch next set of results.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cursor and result set, releasing database resources.

methods.name: newCursorResultSet
methods.description: Factory method for creating a new CursorResultSet wrapped as a ResultSet.
